workload_summary: Primary workload: low-latency decisioning for financial transactions. Mixed-profile traffic: 60% short chat-like prompts (context <= 256 tokens), 30% embedding/rerank batches, 10% long-form summarization. Peak windows align to market open hours (09:00-11:30 local) and batch re-scoring at 02:00 UTC.
latency_targets: P95 <= 120ms for chat-style queries (256 tokens), P99 <= 250ms; embeddings P95 <= 80ms. Strong emphasis on consistent 95th percentile across regions.
throughput_targets: Sustained throughput target: 12K qps across global footprint during peak; per-region baseline: us-east-1 6K qps, eu-west-1 3K qps, us-west-2 3K qps. Bursting policy: additional 15% capacity available within 60s for short spikes.
reserved_gpu_requirements: Target hardware: mix of A100 40GB and H100 for training-derived models. Initial reserved pool ask: 16 A100 equiv in us-east-1, 8 in eu-west-1, 8 in us-west-2. Planning expects ~30% headroom for failover and degraded-mode traffic; document absolute node counts to support caching warmups and KV cache reload times.
failover_strategy: Primary region handles 60% of load with weighted routing. On regional outage, failover headroom covers 100% of lost region capacity at reduced perf profile (quantized model variant) with priority queuing for high-value traffic. Desired RTO < 90s for routing switch and cache population; grade degradation plan: full capacity at ~85% perf and fallback to lower-cost models if latency SLOs broken.
slo_and_sla_negotiations: Customer requests: financial SLA (uptime 99.95%), P95 latency SLO in contract, credits tied to both availability and tail latency. They want explicit network egress cost caps and reserved commit discounts. Legal wants explicit definitions for 'region' and 'AZ' failover, and a runbook attached for multi-region failover exercises.
poC_and_evaluation_criteria: POC success criteria: sustained 72h of peak-window throughput within 10% of requested qps, P95 latency met for 95% of test windows, failover test that demonstrates < 180s to restore tail latencies within target. Also cost comparison sheet showing projected unit-cost improvements vs current infra.
